text:
alex: quick q — when auto-fallback kicks in for a rollout, do we show operators a detailed "degrade reason" (error code + text) in the inbox, or just a short "degraded" state with an audit link? worried about noise.

maria: vote for short state + audit link. if every sampled fallback posts full text the operator inbox will drown. +1 for storing details in telemetry so we can query.

jordan: agreed. UX idea: show a tiny badge on the rollout row with a 1-letter trigger (E/L/Q) and tooltip. then `View audit` opens the trace with full reason and a request sample.

alex: thinking two-tier: (1) compact badge + tooltip in the console, (2) full details behind an "inspect" panel/ link that includes `audit_id`, stack-ish trace, and an anonymized request sample. also need to persist the reason in logs for at least 30d.

sara: from a design POV keep it to three visible states only: "soft-degrade (sampled)", "hard-degrade (all)", and "fallback" (route to alt model). each state gets an icon + one-line message. expansion reveals cause (latency/error/quota) and the audit id.

alex: solid. for messaging text examples: "Served lower-quality variant due to latency spike (audit 1748904321)" — short and actionable.

dev-bot: config note: schema needs `degrade_reason_code` and `audit_trace_id` fields in the event payload. Example snippet:
```yaml
degrade_policy:
  enabled: true
  reasons: [error, latency, quota]
  persist_days: 30
```

maria: also: operator wants a "why?" link that filters the audit timeline to matching triggers (same route/model). helps triage repeated noisy sampling.

jordan: +1. telemetry should attach `rollout_id`, `policy_version`, and `audit_id` to each sampled event to make joins easy.

alex: I'll update the mockups to include the badge + inspect panel + "why?" quick-filter. assigning audit link flow to @maria. I'll add a small note to the runbook about when to alert SRE vs when to file a product-ticket. :thumbsup:

maria: on it. will also create a compact copy string for the inbox notification.

sara: tiny UI nit — when state is "soft-degrade" we should gray out the "rollback" CTA (to avoid confusing operators).

alex: good call. will add. wrapping up — thanks all.
